evals.prompt:
Format this BMI report for email:
BMI: 22.5 (Normal)
Your BMI is in the healthy range.

Health Tips:
- Continue balanced nutrition
- Maintain regular exercise
- Stay hydrated
evals.expected_output: Gmail-compatible HTML email with inline CSS, BMI result, health tips, and disclaimer.
assertions: Output is valid HTML
All CSS is inline (no <style> tags or CSS classes)
Red Hat header present with #CC0000 background
BMI value (22.5) and category (Normal) displayed in highlight box
Health tips rendered as a list
Disclaimer footer present: 'This is not medical advice. Consult a healthcare professional.'
Max width is 600px on container
All inline styles use proper syntax (style="...")

evals.prompt:
Create email body for:
BMI: 17.8 (Underweight)

Tips:
- Eat nutrient-dense foods
- Increase meal frequency
- Add healthy fats
evals.expected_output: HTML email with BMI result and tips sections, no empty placeholders.
assertions: BMI result section rendered
Health tips section rendered
No empty sections or placeholder text
Disclaimer is included (mandatory)
Red Hat header included
Inline CSS only
Proper section dividers (hr tags with inline styles)

evals.prompt: Format for email - just the BMI: 28.3 (Overweight). No tips available this time.
evals.expected_output: Email with BMI section only, tips section skipped entirely (not present as empty).
assertions: BMI section is present with value 28.3 and Overweight category
Health tips section is NOT present (skipped, not rendered empty)
Disclaimer footer is still included
Header is still included
No empty sections, headings without content, or placeholder text
Valid HTML structure maintained
